statement: Use the 3191/3192 toy quadratic projected-source functional.
Define the compact source momentum variable.
Varying a second-derivative functional gives boundary terms multiplying deltaF and deltaFprime.
The momentum multiplying deltaFprime is proportional to u.
The momentum multiplying deltaF is dL/dFprime minus the derivative of dL/dF''.
With no localized interface action and no fixed representative boundary data, both boundary momenta must be continuous across each join.
